observations.behavior: Adds a helper function `_last_run_at` that returns the most recent of two timestamps: the last full run completion and the last successful row extraction, while preserving timezone-awareness and handling malformed inputs. This replaces the previous staleness check that relied solely on `last_synced_at`.
